credits/credit-access-runtime: Nonvisual credit-access lifecycle; credit UI has separate stories.
dev/dev-runtime: Nonvisual development runtime loader; dev-utility-dock has a story.
onboarding/onboarding-provider: Automatic onboarding lifecycle; each dialog has a separate story.
telemetry-identity: Nonvisual analytics identity side effect; telemetry is disabled in Storybook.
theme-font-styles: Injects font styles rather than a standalone UI.
theme-provider: Theme context; the workshop provides theme state and a theme toolbar.
theme-script: Pre-hydration theme script with no standalone UI.
